title: Hamiltonian-Generated Dynamics and Quantum Resource Allocation in a 4-Qubit Isotropic Heisenberg Spin Ring with Adjustable Next-Nearest-Neighbor Interactions
summary: This investigation delivers a fully analytical solution for the unitary evolution of a four-qubit isotropic Heisenberg XXX ring with periodic boundary conditions and a tunable next-nearest-neighbor exchange parameter \(α\). Adopting a Bell-type product state as the initial condition, we obtain closed-form expressions for the square-root fidelity \(F(ρ(0),ρ(t))=|\cos(φ/2)|\), the global \(l_1\)-norm coherence \(C_{l_1}(ρ(t))=\sin^2(φ/2)\), and the bipartite entanglement of formation \(E_F(t)\) for the reduced pairs \((1,2)\) and \((3,4)\).
